questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: La dolce vita - enjoying life in all aspects

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Be open and interested in getting to know Italians. 
2. Learn a bit of the Italian language - they will appreciate that. 
3. Even though UNIMI doesn't give any information in the beginning, don't stress about it, because everything will work out

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: You will find out all of the practical and formal aspects of the courses along the way, so be prepared to not be in  control over everything when you start your semester

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Getting to know the Italian culture (and adopting to it) and friendships

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: I didn't really have any challenges, but I wish I would have learned some of the Italian language, as that is very helpful
